0.content:
# 🤖 Claude Developers Usage

Uso do Claude pelos desenvolvedores em um único dashboard: custo, tokens, adoção, performance e cache. Alimentado pelos spans `gen_ai.*` emitidos pelo hook do Claude Code (Claude Desktop, claude CLI, VS Code) e pelas métricas nativas do Claude Code. Filtros: `Provider` (anthropic) e `Modelo`.

11.title: Custo estimado (USD)
11.query:
fetch logs
| filter in(service.name, {"claude-code", "claude-code-desktop"}) and event.name == "api_request"
| filter in(model, $Modelo)
| summarize total = sum(toDouble(cost_usd))

12.title: Requests
12.query:
fetch spans
| filter contains(gen_ai.request.model, "claude") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "opus") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "sonnet") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "haiku") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "fable")
| filter isNotNull(gen_ai.request.model) and not(contains(gen_ai.request.model,"embedding")) and not(contains(gen_ai.request.model,"metis"))
| filter in(gen_ai.provider.name, $Provider)
| filter in(gen_ai.request.model, $Modelo)
| summarize requests=count()

13.title: Sessões
13.query:
fetch spans
| filter contains(gen_ai.request.model, "claude") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "opus") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "sonnet") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "haiku") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "fable")
| filter isNotNull(gen_ai.request.model) and not(contains(gen_ai.request.model,"embedding")) and not(contains(gen_ai.request.model,"metis"))
| filter in(gen_ai.provider.name, $Provider)
| filter in(gen_ai.request.model, $Modelo)
| filter isNotNull(gen_ai.conversation.id)
| summarize sessions=countDistinct(gen_ai.conversation.id)

14.title: Devs ativos
14.query:
fetch spans
| filter contains(gen_ai.request.model, "claude") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "opus") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "sonnet") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "haiku") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "fable")
| filter isNotNull(gen_ai.request.model) and not(contains(gen_ai.request.model,"embedding")) and not(contains(gen_ai.request.model,"metis"))
| filter in(gen_ai.provider.name, $Provider)
| filter in(gen_ai.request.model, $Modelo)
| filter isNotNull(user.email)
| summarize devs=countDistinct(user.email)

15.title: Modelos
15.query:
fetch spans
| filter contains(gen_ai.request.model, "claude") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "opus") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "sonnet") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "haiku") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "fable")
| filter isNotNull(gen_ai.request.model) and not(contains(gen_ai.request.model,"embedding")) and not(contains(gen_ai.request.model,"metis"))
| filter in(gen_ai.provider.name, $Provider)
| filter in(gen_ai.request.model, $Modelo)
| summarize modelos=countDistinct(gen_ai.request.model)

21.title: Custo por modelo (USD)
21.query:
fetch logs
| filter in(service.name, {"claude-code", "claude-code-desktop"}) and event.name == "api_request"
| filter in(model, $Modelo)
| summarize cost = sum(toDouble(cost_usd)), by: {model}
| sort cost desc

22.title: Custo por time (USD)
22.query:
fetch logs
| filter in(service.name, {"claude-code", "claude-code-desktop"}) and event.name == "api_request"
| filter in(model, $Modelo)
| summarize cost = sum(toDouble(cost_usd)), by: {user.team}

23.title: Tokens ao longo do tempo por modelo
23.query:
fetch logs
| filter in(service.name, {"claude-code", "claude-code-desktop"}) and event.name == "api_request"
| filter in(model, $Modelo)
| makeTimeseries tokens = sum(toLong(input_tokens) + toLong(cache_read_tokens) + toLong(cache_creation_tokens) + toLong(output_tokens)), by: {model}

24.title: Top devs por custo (USD)
24.query:
fetch logs
| filter in(service.name, {"claude-code", "claude-code-desktop"}) and event.name == "api_request"
| filter in(model, $Modelo)
| filter isNotNull(user.email)
| summarize cost = sum(toDouble(cost_usd)), tokens = sum(toLong(input_tokens) + toLong(cache_read_tokens) + toLong(cache_creation_tokens) + toLong(output_tokens)), requests = count(), by: {dev = user.email, user.team}
| sort cost desc
| limit 20

31.title: Latência por modelo (p50/p95)
31.query:
fetch spans
| filter contains(gen_ai.request.model, "claude") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "opus") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "sonnet") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "haiku") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "fable")
| filter isNotNull(gen_ai.request.model) and not(contains(gen_ai.request.model,"embedding")) and not(contains(gen_ai.request.model,"metis"))
| filter in(gen_ai.provider.name, $Provider)
| filter in(gen_ai.request.model, $Modelo)
| summarize p50=percentile(duration,50), p95=percentile(duration,95), requests=count(), by:{gen_ai.request.model}
| sort p95 desc

32.title: Erros por modelo
32.query:
fetch spans
| filter contains(gen_ai.request.model, "claude") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "opus") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "sonnet") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "haiku") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "fable")
| filter isNotNull(gen_ai.request.model) and not(contains(gen_ai.request.model,"embedding")) and not(contains(gen_ai.request.model,"metis"))
| filter in(gen_ai.provider.name, $Provider)
| filter in(gen_ai.request.model, $Modelo)
| summarize total=count(), errors=countIf(span.status_code=="error"), by:{gen_ai.request.model}
| fieldsAdd error_rate=round(toDouble(errors)/toDouble(total)*100, decimals:2)
| sort error_rate desc

41.title: Uso por família de modelo
41.query:
fetch spans
| filter contains(gen_ai.request.model, "claude") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "opus") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "sonnet") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "haiku") or contains(gen_ai.request.model, "fable")
| filter isNotNull(gen_ai.request.model) and not(contains(gen_ai.request.model,"embedding")) and not(contains(gen_ai.request.model,"metis"))
| filter in(gen_ai.provider.name, $Provider)
| filter in(gen_ai.request.model, $Modelo)
| fieldsAdd familia=if(contains(gen_ai.request.model,"claude") or contains(gen_ai.request.model,"opus") or contains(gen_ai.request.model,"sonnet") or contains(gen_ai.request.model,"haiku"),"Claude",else:if(contains(gen_ai.request.model,"gpt"),"GPT",else:if(contains(gen_ai.request.model,"gemini"),"Gemini",else:"Outros")))
| summarize requests=count(), by:{familia}
| sort requests desc

43.title: Top devs por consumo
43.query:
fetch logs

70.content:
### 🧠 Prompt caching
> Tokens lidos e gravados no cache de prompt do Claude (cache_read / cache_creation).

71.title: AVG Cache Read Tokens
71.query:
fetch logs
| filter in(service.name, {"claude-code", "claude-code-desktop"}) and event.name == "api_request"
| filter in(model, $Modelo)
| summarize avg_cache = avg(toDouble(cache_read_tokens))

72.title: Cache Hit
72.query:
fetch logs
| filter in(service.name, {"claude-code", "claude-code-desktop"}) and event.name == "api_request"
| filter in(model, $Modelo)
| summarize cr = sum(toDouble(cache_read_tokens)), allin = sum(toDouble(input_tokens) + toDouble(cache_read_tokens) + toDouble(cache_creation_tokens))
| fieldsAdd hit_pct = round(cr / allin * 100, decimals: 2)

| filter isNotNull(gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens)

| filter in(gen_ai.request.model, $Modelo)

cw0.content:
### 🤝 Cowork e chat unificado (claude.ai)
> Eventos OTel que o console admin do claude.ai exporta (`service.name = cowork`): sessões Cowork no Desktop e na nuvem e, com *Chat and Cowork unified* ligado, as conversas do chat. Custo é o `cost_usd` reportado pela Anthropic. Esses tiles não usam os filtros Provider/Modelo, que leem spans.

cw1.title: Custo Cowork (USD)
cw1.query:
fetch logs
| filter service.name == "cowork" and event.name == "api_request"
| summarize total = sum(toDouble(cost_usd))

cw2.title: Requests Cowork
cw2.query:
fetch logs
| filter service.name == "cowork" and event.name == "api_request"
| summarize total = count()

cw3.title: Devs ativos Cowork
cw3.query:
fetch logs
| filter service.name == "cowork" and event.name == "api_request"
| summarize total = countDistinct(user.email)

cw4.title: Tokens Cowork
cw4.query:
fetch logs
| filter service.name == "cowork" and event.name == "api_request"
| summarize total = sum(toLong(input_tokens) + toLong(output_tokens) + toLong(cache_read_tokens) + toLong(cache_creation_tokens))

cw5.title: Tokens Cowork ao longo do tempo por modelo

cw6.title: Top devs no Cowork por custo (USD)
cw6.query:
fetch logs
| filter service.name == "cowork" and event.name == "api_request"
| summarize cost_usd = sum(toDouble(cost_usd)), tokens = sum(toLong(input_tokens) + toLong(output_tokens) + toLong(cache_read_tokens) + toLong(cache_creation_tokens)), requests = count(), by: {dev = user.email, surface = cowork.surface}
| sort cost_usd desc
| limit 20
